pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: With the current setting, arrows do not deal damage; trident damage and fall damage are rejected separately. Bring melee equipment and room to leave a frontal

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: strike. A falling guard does not automatically take fall damage.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Long Stick Half. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
